# Search Console for iOS

> Independent native iOS app for Google Search Console. Not made by or affiliated with Google LLC. Uses Google's official Search Console API so you can review traffic, queries, Core Web Vitals, URL inspection, and sitemaps on iPhone and iPad.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.search-console.org/): Product overview, features, screenshots, and App Store download.
- [Blog](https://www.search-console.org/blog.html): Practical SEO tips to improve your site using Search Console data.
- [FAQ](https://www.search-console.org/faq.html): 17 questions on data access, Google affiliation, pricing, iPad support, and sign-in.
- [About](https://www.search-console.org/about.html): Author, product story, and independence from Google.
- [Release history](https://www.search-console.org/releases.html): Changelog for the iOS app.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.search-console.org/privacy.html): OAuth, analytics, ads, and California privacy rights.
- [Terms of service](https://www.search-console.org/terms.html): Subscription and usage terms.

## App

- [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/search-console/id6758431981)
- Pricing: free plan with ads for one property. Pro is USD 5.99/month with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers, or USD 1.99/week, via App Store subscription. Cancel anytime in iOS Settings.
- Blink: an on-device assistant (version 2.5 and later) that answers questions about the user's own Search Console data, builds PDF reports, and sends alerts when clicks change. Requires a device with Apple Intelligence. Questions are processed on the device.
